theme_strategy: Light mode by default. For a food and grocery app, a light theme conveys cleanliness, freshness, and hygiene. Dark themes can feel unappetizing in this context. Surfaces should use pure white with subtle gray offsets for structural hierarchy.

spacing_and_layout.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-white relative shadow-2xl overflow-hidden

component_guidelines.Header: Sticky top positioning (z-40). bg-white border-b border-gray-100 p-4. Contains user location ('Ward No. 8, Gularbhoj Road'), profile icon, and prominent search bar.
component_guidelines.BottomNav: Fixed to bottom (z-50). bg-white border-t border-gray-100 flex justify-between px-6 py-3 pb-safe-area. Icons for Home, Categories, Cart, Profile.
component_guidelines.ProductCard: Vertical layout. rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 p-3 bg-white. Image at top (aspect-square object-contain), Title and Price below. Add to cart button is small, rounded-xl, green. Highlight discounts with small tags.
component_guidelines.CategoryTile: Square aspect ratio. rounded-xl bg-gray-50 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-3 gap-2. Use soft background colors matching category theme.
component_guidelines.Banner: rounded-2xl overflow-hidden relative w-full h-40. Image cover with dark gradient overlay at bottom for text contrast.
component_guidelines.CartThresholdBar: Prominent sticky banner in the cart showing progress towards ₹500 for free delivery. Use a green progress bar.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 minimum for text against backgrounds. Use text-white on primary green buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build standard React (.js) using Tailwind CSS. Since it targets mobile context, wrap the main app layout in a 'max-w-md mx-auto w-full h-screen overflow-y-auto' container to mimic mobile dimensions on desktop browsers.
Use standard DOM elements styled as app components.
Implement clear bottom navigation for major screens (Home, Categories, Cart, Profile).
Ensure seamless mock OTP login flow.
In the Cart view, create a visual progress bar indicating distance to ₹500 for Free Delivery.
Show a clean timeline layout for Order Statuses (Ordered, Packed, Out for Delivery, Delivered).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' UI. Produce a high-quality, trustworthy e-commerce mobile experience.
DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato for Headings. Stick to the suggested Outfit (or similar modern geometric sans).
Incorporate micro-animations. Every tap should have a reaction (e.g., active:scale-95).
Never use transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays; ensure solid or glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90) is applied.
DO NOT center align large blocks of text; left-align naturally.
Never use generic placeholders. Only use the provided Unsplash/Pexels image URLs.
Apply 'data-testid' to ALL buttons, inputs, links, and major wrappers to enable automated testing.
